title: quorum cross-refutation — attacks on the other legs' plans
description: Structured output contract for a refute leg. Mirrors the bar in refute-plan.md — do not add fields here without updating that prompt to match. Targets are anonymized as plan-1/plan-2; provider labels reattach only at synthesis.

critiques.description: One entry per plan under attack.

target.description: Which plan this critique addresses, by payload label.

attacks.description: Empty is a valid verdict — nothing genuinely wrong was found.

where.description: The step or claim in the plan under attack.

what.description: The failure: what does not hold, is missing, or breaks when executed as written.

basis.description: The receipt: the brief line, pack fact, or plan step it rests on. 'Seems thin' is not a basis.
